Requires both directions of job creation, history visibility, attempts and semantic result provenance on the exact candidate build.
Requires a second real owner to receive no list or direct-object access.
Requires the production Mini and Web routes after the switched evidence is sealed.
Requires a real accepted production Chat write and both-direction reload/continuation.
Requires a real accepted production SimC write and matching status, attempt, result and provenance on both clients.
Requires API/Worker restart recovery, queue continuity, Nginx/TLS, database sessions, legacy read-only state and explicit user confirmation.

candidateDeployment.reason: The last reviewed cloud inventory has about 8.58 GB free on one root device. No independent encrypted backup plus successful isolated restore identity exists, so chickenbro_candidate was not provisioned and no candidate service, database, Nginx route or public artifact was changed.

runtimeEvidence.detail: wow_test is about 16.38 GB, PostgreSQL is about 39.63 GB and root free space is about 8.58 GB. This cannot prove safe candidate, restore and rollback coexistence.
Only the root block device is mounted; the visible system snapshot is stale and untested, and no reviewed server-side independent backup channel or restore identity exists.

Read-only inspection confirmed the legacy API/Worker and scheduled writer set remain active as last-known-good, while the old wow-v2-api-candidate occupies port 8791. The candidate deploy control now retires and restores that exact old candidate service around the new isolated candidate; no service was changed.

The cutover remains preflight-only. Apply requires exact clean commit, inventory, restore-verified backup, candidate evidence and real candidate acceptance hashes. accepted_write additionally requires exact post-cutover production acceptance bound to switched evidence and explicit user confirmation.

risks.detail: A clean candidate and rollback copy cannot safely be created until storage expands or independently recoverable legacy cleanup frees enough space, followed by a fresh inventory and successful restore proof.
No official candidate Mini publication, real wx.login, QR confirmation, cross-client Chat/SimC or second-owner isolation evidence exists.
Production remains on legacy. The apply script can stop only at switched; accepted_write is sealed only after an actual post-cutover write and real-user acceptance evidence.
The production WeApp build is content-addressed locally but still needs official upload/release evidence for the same commit and build identity before final acceptance.
Any later apply must use a fresh probe-error-free inventory within the script freshness window and the exact reviewed SHA.

cleanup.reason: All legacy runtime, data and rollback assets remain intact. Phase 6 deletion is prohibited until production accepted_write, user acceptance, a stability window and new-data-plane recovery proof are complete.

summary: Phase 5 is locally verified for separated credential transports, the exact two-tab/five-route clients, formal shared-history Chat/SimC flows, idempotent whitelist migration, isolated candidate controls and a monotonic fenced cutover with separate switched and accepted_write evidence. Fresh migration and deployment-control tests pass, while the exact production H5/WeApp builds and broader client/application checks remain local evidence only. Candidate apply, real WeChat acceptance, production cutover, first accepted write and all Phase 6 deletion remain blocked by capacity, independent recovery and user-acceptance gates. No cloud service, database, route or data was changed.
